title: NBI readies arrest of Bato dela Rosa; warns of possible ‘encounter’

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) Director Melvin Matibag said on Monday that the bureau will arrest Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa with the least possible violence, noting that an “encounter” may happen in locating him. In an interview, Matibag noted dela Rosa’s background as a former chief of the Philippine National Police (PNP) and someone from law enforcement service, saying that “he definitely has friends that will probably be helping him.” He also pointed out that the senator had not surrendered all of his firearms.
